entries.en: The door seems to be locked[n]from the other side...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: We should focus on chasing after Sae-san[n]for now!
entries.uk: Поки що зосередьмося на тому,[n]щоб наздогнати пані Сае!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It won't open. Could it perhaps be[n]blocked from the other side?
entries.uk: Не відчиняються. Може, їх заблоковано[n]з іншого боку?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We should probably try to look for[n]another way through.
